he key org's Default project. Most users never call these directly; set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` and the [SDK reporter](https://docs.mcpja

m.com/sdk/concepts/saving-results.md) does:

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `POST .../eval-ingest/report` | One-shot:
create a run from finished results and finalize it |\n| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/start` | Chunked flow: create (or idempotently
reuse) a run by `externalRunId` |\n| `POST .../eval-ingest/runs/iterations` | Append an iteration batch to a started run |\n| `PO
ST .../eval-ingest/runs/finalize` | Finalize a chunked run (idempotent) |\n| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts` | Store one artifact
's raw bytes (widget HTML too large to send inline) and return its `storageId` |\n| `POST .../eval-ingest/artifacts/upload-url` |
Retired. Answers `410 Gone` with `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload artifacts with `P

OST .../eval-ingest/artifacts` instead |

**Agent** (`/projects/{projectId}/agent`): a headless assistant turn for
building con

versational surfaces:

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `POST .../agent` | Run ONE assistant turn over a `messages` his
tory (`{role: \"user\"\\|\"assistant\", content}` items, max 50 messages × 8 KB each, 96 KB total). The model is pinned server-sid
e and billed to the project. The turn can read project servers/suites/runs and **create eval suites**; it can NOT start runs: kick
those off yourself with `POST .../eval-runs`. Responds synchronously with `reply`, the `toolCalls` it made, `createdResources` (i
ds + app links), and token `usage`. Capped at 4 concurrent turns per organization and \\~90 s wall clock. **Not idempotent; never
blind-retry**: dedupe on your own trigger identity, and on an error response check `details.createdResources` (and, after a lost r

esponse, list suites) before retrying, or you'll create duplicates |

**Studies** (`/projects/{projectId}/studies...`):

| End
point | What it does |\n| - | - |\n| `GET .../studies` | List the project's published studies: name, access mode, attached servers
, share link |\n| `GET .../studies/{studyId}` | One study's full read: model, system prompt, tool-approval policy, resolved server
s, the environment it publishes, and its insights envelope. The last two need workspace membership and are **absent** for a share-

link visitor, never null |

**Swarms, authoring** (`/projects/{projectId}/personas...`, `.../goals...`,
`.../swarms...`): the d
efinitions a swarm run executes. A **persona** is a\nreusable synthetic character; a **goal** is the task you point one at; a\n**s
warm** is an authoring container holding defaults for the goals made\nunder it. Nothing here starts anything; launching is\n`POST

.../goals/{goalId}/runs`.

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `GET .../personas` | List the project's personas |
| `POST
.../personas` | Create a persona (accepts `Idempotency-Key`) |\n| `GET .../personas/{personaId}` | One persona |\n| `PATCH .../pe
rsonas/{personaId}` | Update a persona. Goals reference it by id, so renaming is safe |\n| `DELETE .../personas/{personaId}` | Del
ete a persona. **409** while goals still reference it |\n| `GET .../goals` | List the project's goals |\n| `POST .../goals` | Crea
te a goal (accepts `Idempotency-Key`). `personaId` and `swarmId` must be in this project |\n| `GET .../goals/{goalId}` | One goal
|\n| `PATCH .../goals/{goalId}` | Update a goal. `null` CLEARS `environmentIds`; `iterations` and `maxTurns` must be sent together
|\n| `DELETE .../goals/{goalId}` | **Archive** a goal; existing runs keep pointing at the definition they executed |\n| `GET .../
swarms` | List swarm containers |\n| `POST .../swarms` | Create a swarm container (accepts `Idempotency-Key`) |\n| `GET .../swarms
/{swarmId}` | One swarm |\n| `PATCH .../swarms/{swarmId}` | Update the container's defaults. Not a cascade; existing goals keep th

eir own values |
| `DELETE .../swarms/{swarmId}` | **Archive** a swarm. The goals under it stay launchable |

**Swarms, generat
ion**. Drafts a model writes for you. Both routes return\ncandidates and **persist nothing**: feed what you want to keep to the cr

eate
routes above. Neither accepts an `Idempotency-Key`, and retries return
different drafts.

| Endpoint | What it does |
|
- | - |\n| `POST .../personas/generate` | Draft a slate of personas (and goals for each) grounded in a server attachment or an env

ironment |
| `POST .../goals/generate` | Draft goals for a persona passed **by value**, so you can draft before you save |

> [

!WARNING]
>
> The generation routes consume **no customer credits** (the model cost is on
> MCPJam). They are still subject to
usage limits, and each limit means a\n> different wait: a per-minute burst brake (`429`, retry in seconds), your\n> organization's
daily generation quota (`429`, resets at UTC midnight), and\n> MCPJam's own daily budget for the feature (`429` with\n> `details.
code: \"platform_capacity\"`, resets at UTC midnight). All three carry\n> `Retry-After`. Honor it rather than guessing. `details.c
anTopUp` is `false`\n> on every one: buying credits does not lift them, so do not retry in a loop\n> or switch identities to get a

round them.

**Swarms, runs** (`/projects/{projectId}/goals/{goalId}/runs`,
`.../goal-runs/...`): launching a goal and reading

what it produced:

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `GET .../goals/{goalId}/runs` | That goal's runs, newest first |
|
`POST .../goals/{goalId}/runs` | **Launch.** Answers `202`; the fan-out has started, not finished. Send `Idempotency-Key`. Option
al `expectedSponsored` is how many conversations you expect MCPJam to sponsor; a different actual split is a `409` (`details.code:
swarm_funding_changed`) and nothing is created. The response can report `funding` (`sponsored`, `credits`, `total`) |\n| `GET ...
/goal-runs/{runId}` | The full run: counts, per-target breakdown, per-session `attempts` |\n| `GET .../goal-runs/{runId}/sessions`
| The chat sessions the run produced (summaries, not transcripts) |\n| `POST .../goal-runs/{runId}/cancel` | Stop a run. Idempote
nt; a second cancel is `200` with `alreadyCanceled: true`, not a `409` |\n\nThree things worth knowing before you write the client

:

* **Always send `Idempotency-Key` on a launch.** It spends model credits, so a
 retry of a dropped response must not run th
e goal twice. Replaying a key\n returns the original run with `deduped: true` and starts no second runner\n and consumes no quot
a. Omitting the header is read as a request that declined\n to identify itself, and gets a fresh run every time.\n* **Check `canc
eled` before reporting a failure.** A stopped run carries\n `status: \"failed\"`, because cancellation is recorded as a marker ra

ther than
 a status of its own. `stale: true` is the third case: the runner went silent
 and the watchdog settled the run.
*
**`targetId`, not `hostId`, identifies a target.** Two environments can\n resolve to the same host with different servers, so a r

un can hold two
 targets that share a `hostId`.

> [!WARNING]
>
> Launching **spends**: a run fans out into `targets × itera
tions`\n> sessions. Two different `429`s can come back; the per-minute burst brake\n> (retry in seconds) and your plan's daily lau

nch cap (resets at UTC midnight).
> Both normally carry `Retry-After`; back off on your own when one does not.

**Swarms, insig
hts**: what a run revealed. Read these in order of cost: the\nroll-up and the scorecard are deterministic and free, the findings r

egistry
aggregates them, and swarm run insights run a model.

| Endpoint | What it does |
| - | - |
| `GET .../goals-overview
` | Project roll-up: recent runs, goal-completion rates, repeat failures, trend |\n| `GET .../goal-runs/{runId}/scorecard` | One r
un's deterministic rubric result. No model, no spend |\n| `GET .../goal-findings` | Criteria that keep failing, tracked across swa
rm runs |\n| `POST .../goal-findings/{findingId}/dismiss` | Hide a finding |\n| `POST .../goal-findings/{findingId}/undismiss` | U
n-hide it |\n| `GET .../swarm-runs/{swarmRunId}/insights` | Poll a swarm run's generated insights. **404 = nobody asked** |\n| `PO
ST .../swarm-runs/{swarmRunId}/insights` | Request them. `202`; scheduled, not done |\n| `DELETE .../swarm-runs/{swarmRunId}/insig
